entities.name: Aku
entities.description: Floating fortress city in the Uuserk Marshes of Jamuraa, now part of the plane of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Mundungu
entities.description: Alliance of Shadow Guild and Shaper Guild mages that built Aku.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Warlord whose demons were kept from Aku and who was defeated; held in the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison holding Kaervek, buried in a pillar tomb of Aku.

entities.name: Amber Tombs
entities.description: Domed chamber where prisoners were kept secure.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Phased out northwestern Jamuraa to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Wrenn and Realmbreaker
entities.description: Planeswalker who returned Zhalfir to the multiverse by switching it with New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane whose place Zhalfir's landmass took.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion Aku was phased out to avoid.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Zhalfir was returned.

events.summary: The mundungu built Aku to hold the pillar tombs of Zhalfirin royalty.
events.quote: The city was constructed to hold the pillar tombs of Zhalfirin royalty

events.summary: Aku's mages and djinn kept Kaervek's demons away and helped defeat him.
Teferi phased Aku out with northwestern Jamuraa to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: to spare it from the horrors of the Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, forever losing Aku from Dominaria.
events.quote: It was forever lost from Dominaria after Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned Zhalfir to the multiverse by swapping it with New Phyrexia.
events.quote: returned the phased-out Zhalfir to the multiverse by switching the landmass' place with that of New Phyrexia

events.summary: A warding pendulum snapped and fell during Kaervek's escape.
events.quote: it snapped and fell to the chamber's floor during Kaervek 's escape

relations.quote: Aku was built by the mundungu
Aku now exists as part of the plane of Zhalfir.

relations.note: Its mages kept his demons away.
relations.quote: Its powerful mages and flesh-hungry djinn kept the demons of Kaervek away from it during the war
